team.name: Log-first control
team.instructions: Begin with a controlled log-only inspection phase. All initial workers observe incident telemetry without direct system access. Establish baseline metrics for latency, connection saturation, and readiness under hard service limits. Iteratively refine procedures based on observed patterns while preserving worker counts. Only after correctness is established will config/contract access be granted to selected workers.
